parameters.name: Connect a more verbose model
parameters.description: Some AI models produce more terse results than others. Swapping your model for one with a larger context window and more verbose output can increase the word length of your responses

parameters.name: Increase the maximum number of tokens
parameters.description: Many model nodes (for example the OpenAI Chat Model) include a Maximum Number of Tokens option. You can set this to increase the maximum number of tokens the model can use to produce a response

parameters.name: Build larger responses in stages
parameters.description: For more detailed answers, you may want to construct replies in stages using a variety of AI nodes.
